description: This file defines the BlobReporter class, a test report generator that creates ZIP reports with metadata, attachments, and test results, used within the Playwright testing framework.

classes.name: BlobReporter
classes.description: A class that generates ZIP reports for test results, including metadata and attachments, used in Playwright's reporting system.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the BlobReporter with options, setting up message handling and validating the filename.

methods.name: onConfigure
methods.description: Sets up report metadata including version, user agent, and shard info.

methods.name: onTestPaused
methods.description: No-op method for handling test pause events, relevant only for interactive use.

methods.name: onEnd
methods.description: Finalizes the report by creating a ZIP file with metadata, attachments, and test results.

methods.name: _prepareOutputFile
methods.description: Prepares the output file path, creating necessary directories and cleaning up old reports.

methods.name: _defaultReportName
methods.description: Generates a default report filename based on configuration and command hash.

methods.name: _serializeAttachments
methods.description: Serializes test attachments, adding a hash-based filename to avoid clashes.
